description: Image Description: A serene riverside scene features a row of wooden punts moored along the edge of a calm, greenish river. The boats are neatly aligned, with their flat bottoms and open interiors clearly visible. Each punt is constructed from polished wood, with some showing signs of weathering, and they have green-painted hulls near the waterline.
